title: RecourseContract
description: Machine-readable ex ante autonomy envelope κ = (a, x, ρ, L, P, B, S, Δ). The runtime checks recourse-eligibility against this object before admitting a compensable tool call; the ClaimRegistry resolves residual claims using the same fields.

schemaVersion.description: RecourseContract schema version. Bumping is breaking and resets EIP-712 parity tests.

contractId.description: EIP-712 struct hash of this κ, used as the on-chain identifier.

operator.description: Address of the registering operator. Only this address can revoke.

tool.description: Workload adapter that will execute this template.

descriptor.description: Adapter-specific identifier for the scope. Postgres: {database, schema, table, tenantId}. Git: {repoUrl, ref, branchPattern}. Cloud: {accountId, region, resourceArn}.

effectClass.description: Only 'compensable' actions register a recourse contract. Reversible and excluded actions never reach this stage.

compensatorId.description: Stable identifier of the registered compensator module.

freshnessSeconds.description: Max acceptable age of the snapshot/backup the compensator relies on.

retentionSeconds.description: How long the compensator must retain recovery artifacts after execution.

authPolicyHash.description: Hash of the off-chain authorization policy the compensator runs under.

codes.description: Loss codes the contract is willing to cover.

excludeList.description: Explicit excluded harm classes. main.tex:108 requires this to remain a no-op for non-Recourse harms; listing them defensively documents that scope and forces eligibility to fail if a covered code overlaps an excluded one.

type.description: Family of payout function P(o,r). 'composite' linearly combines the first three.

params.description: Family-specific parameters. rowCountSchedule: {perRowUsd, minPayoutUsd}. downtimeSchedule: {perSecondUsd, thresholdSeconds}. excessSpendSchedule: {coverageRatio, deductibleUsd}. composite: {components: [{type, params, weight}]}.

maxPayout.description: Hard cap in token base units (e.g. USDC has 6 decimals). Stored as a decimal string to preserve uint256 precision across JSON.

asset.description: ERC-20 collateral token address (USDC on the target chain).

minAmount.description: Minimum bonded amount in token base units.

maxAggregateExposure.description: Cap on E_open + P_max admitted under this contract (main.tex:225).

schemaId.description: Hash identifying the evidence-schema definition used by adapter and compensator.

requiredProvenance.description: Minimum provenance level for objective settlement (main.tex:246). L3 cannot satisfy EvidenceOK.

accessPolicyHash.description: Hash of the off-chain policy describing who can read large evidence artifacts during liveness.

recoverySeconds.description: Δ_ρ: max time after the failed action by which a schema-valid RecoveryReceipt must exist (main.tex:263).

submissionSeconds.description: Latest time after the action at which a claimant may open a claim.

arbitrator.description: ERC-792 arbitrator contract address (Kleros L2 or MockArbitrator on testnet).

evidenceGroupId.description: ERC-1497 evidence group identifier this κ uses.
